name: Ace of Swords
meaning_for_today: The solution to a problem you have been puzzling over for a long time will be right in front of you. Be especially attentive today so as not to miss this opportunity, as such chances do not come around every day. However, do not be overly picky about various small details. Simply delve into the essence of the matter and make the right decision.
card_advice: Being decisive even in difficult moments is not as hard as it might seem at first glance. The solution can come like a flash, a sudden insight. Do not commit thoughtless actions; follow the call of logic and reason. Do not worry and doubt everything, because you will only waste energy that could be useful for gathering your thoughts, being attentive, and sensitive to everything. Moreover, increased stress leads to neurotic diseases.

upright.general: The Ace of Swords is a card of triumph and victory. Leave all doubts behind. Bring clarity to all areas of your life; living this way will become much easier and more fun, and you will not have to rack your brains over every little thing every day. You can devote this time to something greater. It is possible that new plans and concepts will be born, which are destined to come true if you put in enough effort. If there is a crisis moment in life right now, the card can be interpreted as the disappearance of troubles. If you have decided on a new venture, do not commit thoughtless actions; act soberly, clearly evaluating your every step. You can use your own power, but do not overdo it. There is a possibility that a new stimulus will appear soon. The person making the spread will get rid of dependencies; a serious conversation or clarifying relationships with a partner awaits them. If illusions are abandoned, the alliance will break up. The card is interpreted as freedom, decisiveness, logic, discipline, and organization. Health problems are not excluded, which can only be solved by surgical intervention. Be sure to visit a doctor and undergo a medical examination. If an uncomfortable and unpleasant situation is happening now, do not despair—a promising project will emerge from it.
upright.in_love: Soon there will be an opportunity to find a common language with your spouse. This has not happened for a long time, and the union has undergone crisis times, but everything will change in the near future. Avoid ambiguity in relationships; there is no place for understatement in love. If a relationship ended recently, the card foreshadows the appearance of a new, strong, and fruitful one. In everyday life, the card symbolizes a sudden outburst of passion that will color life in bright colors, overshadowing all routine. Furious energy will appear, and you will want to conquer your partner and become the best for them. The most common interpretation of the Ace of Swords is the need to fight for the relationship, as there is a possibility of a rival appearing. In addition, the appearance of this card in an upright position indicates an impending pregnancy.
upright.in_situation: Very soon, a new interesting project will begin, which will capture your entire consciousness. It will not just appear as a gift of fate. This is a reward for the nerves, time, and energy spent in a serious conflict. When storm clouds in the form of huge problems appear on life's path, the main thing is to maintain discipline, be decisive, and do not delay. Do not be afraid to make a mistake, unless it is a fatal one—it will be a wonderful lesson. In any case, everything negative will lead to something new and insanely interesting. Focus all your attention on the goal, and a positive result will not keep you waiting.

reversed.short: Blow of fate, problems, separation, failure in affairs.
reversed.general: The Ace of Swords in a reversed position indicates that the problem you are currently working on is unsolvable. In the near future, separation from family or divorce from a spouse awaits, and this will become a real blow of fate. The card warns of problems not only with management but also with the law. This will happen as a result of injustice, abuse of power, or violence. The person making the spread is seriously ill. They may have an injury resulting from a wound. Surgery is required, which may occur with complications. A long-awaited pregnancy will turn into complete disappointment, because an unexpected break with a partner with whom there was a serious and long-term relationship will occur.
reversed.in_love: In a reading on a lover's character, the card indicates their uncompromising nature, conflict-prone behavior, and tactless straightforwardness. The possibility of violence is not excluded, where a partner may win the object of their dreams through rudeness. When a person is overly emotional, it prevents them from thinking soberly and clearly and from evaluating the situation. If the Ace of Swords falls to a woman, it is very likely she is pregnant, and this situation will end in an abortion because the child is unexpected and unwanted. In the event that the female representative decides to keep the child, the birth will be difficult. Due to a lack of restraint, complete confusion arises in relationships, which entails big problems.
reversed.in_situation: There is a possibility that someone close to you is using you. A feeling may arise that a simple task requires too much energy and time. Be careful in everything! Do not overdo it when you start putting your life in order, throwing out everything that brings negative emotions. If there was a situation earlier where you hurt or offended someone, the time of retribution for this is coming.

major.01: Greatest wisdom or greatest foolishness; conception; open-mindedness; a meaningless venture.
major.02: A sophisticated idea; taking up the sword of victory.
major.07: Bringing clarity to relationships; fighting for a relationship.
major.16: A devilish plan; a fixed idea.
major.17: Destroying false ideas; freeing the mind.

cups.02: An honest conversation; clearing up a relationship.
cups.07: Dispelling illusions; making a clear choice.

pentacles.02: The need to make a practical decision.
pentacles.05: Finding a way out of a financial crisis.
pentacles.06: A fair agreement; legal financial assistance.

wands.02: A project that requires comprehension and evaluation of prospects; a planned pregnancy.
wands.08: An internet message; catching an idea on the fly.
wands.10: An unviable project; an idea that failed the test.
wands.12: An idea that leads us into the abyss of the unknown.
